Our cleaning services

A clean for
everyday life.

A regular refresh, a thorough deep clean or help before a move. Tell us about your space and we’ll talk through the right service for you.

01

Regular & general cleaning

Reliable help with the everyday cleaning. Get in touch to discuss the areas you’d like cleaned and how often you need a hand.

02

One-off deep cleaning

For the times your home needs a little extra attention. Let us know your priorities and we’ll put together a quote for your clean.

03

Vacate & end-of-lease cleaning

Moving is busy enough. We can help with the cleaning before you hand back the keys. Share your property details and any agent requirements when you enquire.

04

Airbnb & holiday homes

Cleaning for short-stay accommodation and holiday homes. Contact us to discuss your property, cleaning needs and booking schedule.

05

Rental inspection cleaning

A helping hand before your next rental inspection, with attention to the areas that matter to you.

06

Those extra jobs

Ask us about oven and fridge cleaning, folding laundry and making beds. We’ll confirm what can be included in your booking.

07

Offices & workplaces

Looking for help with your workplace? Tell us about your premises and the cleaning you need so we can discuss a suitable service.
